prompt:

Asset type: website gift certificate product photograph, wide 16:9.
Input images: Image 1 is the current photo to edit and framing reference. Image 2 is the EXACT original red/white/black geometric pattern reference. Image 3 is the EXACT original ЯКОМОГА logo reference.
Primary request: Regenerate ONLY this gift certificate photo. A SINGLE BLACK PLASTIC GIFT CARD, with rounded corners and a thin clearly visible rigid plastic edge, on a light neutral surface. Preserve the current premium, photorealistic, minimal daylight product photography and readable slightly angled card front, in 16:9.
Card design: Use the original ЯКОМОГА sign/logo from Image 3 with its exact recognisable red circle, black forelock, closed eyes and moustache; preserve its original shape and original custom wordmark letterforms, using white wordmark on the black card. Place the logo in the upper portion, leaving a spacious clean black field below. Add the exact Ukrainian title “Подарунковий сертифікат” in clear readable white type on the clean black card face. Add the denomination “1000 грн” in larger white type, also entirely on CLEAN SOLID BLACK.
CRITICAL pattern constraint: The original pattern from Image 2 appears ONLY as a SMALL THIN stripe flush at the very BOTTOM edge of the card. The stripe occupies just 8% of total card height, with an ABSOLUTE maximum of 10%. All remaining 90–92% of the card face is clean black. There must be a clear black gap between “1000 грн” and the stripe. The denomination NEVER overlaps or sits on any pattern. Do not preserve the large pattern area from Image 1: replace it with clean black.
Text (verbatim): “ЯКОМОГА”; “Подарунковий сертифікат”; “1000 грн”. The gift title is Ukrainian and must be clearly legible and correctly spelled, with the word “сертифікат” ending “кат”. Keep original logo tagline “ДОСТАВКА ЗАДОВОЛЕННЯ” if included as part of the original logo.
Materials: black rigid plastic with subtle smooth satin texture, a credible thin plastic edge and soft natural shadow; not fibrous paper, not cardboard.
Composition/framing: one card only, clear readable front, slight angle on warm light neutral tabletop, 16:9 landscape with restrained margins similar to Image 1. Highest quality realistic daylight photo.
Avoid: paper certificate, paper texture, extra cards, hands, envelopes, props, unrelated branding, newly invented logos, redesigned original logo shape, oversize pattern, pattern behind denomination, unreadable text, watermark.
